title: WHILE Loop
description: Learn how to use the WHILE statement to create loops in T-SQL.

data.text: The WHILE statement executes a statement block repeatedly as long as a specified condition is TRUE.

data.title: WHILE loop syntax
data.content: Repeats a block while a condition is true.

data.title: Print numbers 1 to 5
data.content: Uses a WHILE loop to print numbers.

data.title: WHILE Loop Key Points
points: WHILE loops execute while a condition is TRUE.
Change variables inside the loop to avoid infinite loops.
Use BREAK to exit the loop and CONTINUE to skip an iteration.
WHILE loops are often used with cursors for row-by-row processing.
